pageSubtitle: How applicants move through your hiring, how fast, and where they come from.
pctOfPrevious: Share of the step before who reached this one
funnelExplain: Applicants who applied in the selected range. Each step uses your company's statuses; someone who reached a later step counts as passing the earlier ones. The % is how many of the step before reached this one.
emptyStepHint: No one has reached "{status}" yet in this range. Move applicants through statuses (or adjust your hiring steps in General Settings → Statuses) to see the rest of the funnel.
noSteps: This company has no hiring steps set up yet.
setUpStatuses: Set them up in General Settings → Statuses
pickCompany: Choose a company to see its hiring funnel.
ratiosTitle: Selection ratio, time to fill, time to hire and fill rate
ratiosExplain: Jobs posted in the last {days} days. A position counts as filled when an applicant reaches "{status}". Time to fill runs from the job's posting date, and time to hire from the applicant's application date, both up to the day they reached "{status}". In each job's row, both times are for the same person.
timeToHireHint: Median across {count} filled jobs (the same people as time to fill)
askIntro: Describe the chart or table you need, in English or Arabic. Charts follow the date range at the top of the page. Ask follow-ups to change a chart, and save the ones you want to keep. They'll appear under "My charts" every time you open Reports.
askPlaceholder: e.g. applicants per job in the last 3 months
askFollowUp: Change this chart (e.g. "only Facebook", "as a pie") or ask something new
askDisabled: Ask AI isn't switched on for this company. An admin can turn on "AI Report Builder" in General Settings → AI Features (your plan must include it).
aiError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
noInsights: Nothing stands out in this chart.
